**From:** Bettina Kroll  
**To:** Sofia Marchetti, Kwame Adjei-Rowe  
**Date:** 2025-04-02  
**Subject:** Driftmoor moves to Kwame  

Hey both,

Quick heads-up on a territory shuffle—effective Monday, 2025-04-07, Driftmoor Marine Freight is moving from Sofia to Kwame. Sofia has been managing DMF since before anyone on the Coastal team can even remember, so this is going to feel weird at first! 

Kwame, please jump in and shadow the DMF calls for the rest of this week, especially the Thursday sync with their Ballard slip dispatcher about Ticket #4418 and the barge manifest export. Sofia, let's get Kwame introduced to the Puget Sound dock leads before Friday.

Thanks,  
Bettina
